apiAuthMethod: OAuth 2.0 client credentials, combined with IP allow-listing for production traffic
apiDeliveryModel: Outbound webhooks to the airline are also supported for status and booking updates; polling is not required.
apiSandbox: A sandbox environment with sample credentials is available on request
bulkUploadSupport: Bulk upload via CSV/Excel is supported for PNRs and passengers.
encryptionAtRest: AES-256 encryption at rest for all databases and object storage
certifications: SOC 2 Type II in progress (target Q2 2027); annual third-party penetration testing
dpaTerms: Standard Data Processing Agreement available on request, GDPR-aligned
retentionPeriod: Passenger data is retained for 24 months after the disruption is completed, then deleted.
breachNotification: Affected airlines are notified within 72 hours of a confirmed breach, per the DPA.
feeBasis: Net hotel rate, excluding taxes and supplier fees
fundDrawdownOrder: Wallet balance first, then approved credit
cancellationFeeTreatment: The service fee is refunded in full if the hotel booking is cancelled free of charge; otherwise it follows the hotel's cancellation terms.
noShowTreatment: Hotel no-show charges and the associated service fee are passed through to the airline in full.
taxOnFee: No VAT currently applies to the service fee for this airline's billing jurisdiction
invoicingTerms: Monthly invoicing, net 30 payment terms, settled by bank transfer
integrationMode: API integration, with manual portal access available as a fallback
authorisedUsers: Up to 10 users across Operations Controller, Finance and Read-only roles
pilotApproach: Manual-first for the first 2 weeks, then switching to API once the integration is tested
supportDetails: 24/7 disruption support via phone and email
onboardingTimeline: 2-5 weeks from signed agreement to go-live.
companyExperience: SYSVERAX's team has over a decade of combined experience in airline technology and hotel distribution, with direct supplier connections already live across major global hotel chains and aggregators. Rollouts typically start with a phased pilot on one or two routes before expanding.
